meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成支持备注和跳转的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常要把资料整理成可演示的幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn your content into a presentation deck with speaker notes and branching.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn rough notes into a navigable slide deck for presenting.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范生成可在浏览器里操作的幻灯片组:包含独立页、逐段揭示、分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注;也可以把已有网页改造成幻灯片组。产出是可导航的演示文稿,不是渲染好的 MP4 视频。
howto.when: 当你说要做幻灯片、演示文稿,或要求把某个页面转成演示时触发;若只是提到“presentation”“deck”等相近词,Claude 会先解释再询问确认。

say.text: 做一份 10 页的 HyperFrames 幻灯片,主题是新品发布
say.note: 会生成可导航的 deck,不是 MP4

say.text: 把这个网页转成幻灯片,保留原来的动效和交互
给第 3 页加一个热点,点击跳到市场测算分支
say.note: 热点会连接到 slideSequences 里的分支

howto.what_en: After install, Claude builds HyperFrames deck files: discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter notes. It confirms intent first and can port an existing page into a deck; output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a slideshow, presentation, or converting a page into a deck; for adjacent requests like "deck" it explains and asks for confirmation first.

say_en.text: Make a 10-slide HyperFrames deck about the product launch.
say_en.note: A navigable deck will be produced, not a video.

say_en.text: Turn this webpage into a slideshow, keeping its motion and interactions.
say_en.note: Claude asks for confirmation before converting.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 3 that jumps to the market-sizing branch.
say_en.note: The hotspot links to a branch sequence.
